description: This file defines the 'Config' class and related nested classes within the WPEFramework plugin namespace. It includes configuration options, JSON serialization, and system path utilities, serving as a central configuration header for a plugin component.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Main configuration class for the plugin, including nested classes for root configuration and system settings.

classes.name: Config::RootConfig
classes.description: Represents the root configuration settings, including mode, locator, user, and remote address.

classes.name: Config::RootObject
classes.description: Internal class used for JSON parsing of the root config object.

classes.name: Config::ModeType
classes.description: Enumeration of different operational modes: OFF, LOCAL, CONTAINER, DISTRIBUTED.

classes.name: Config::startup
classes.description: Enumeration representing startup states: UNAVAILABLE, DEACTIVATED, SUSPENDED, RESUMED.

classes.name: Config::HostType
classes.description: Enumeration representing host types: LOCAL, CONTAINER, DISTRIBUTED.

classes.name: Config::IPV4UnicastNode
classes.description: Static method to retrieve IPv4 unicast node identifier for a given interface name.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: Utility class for logging configuration settings, preventing copying and assignment.

methods.name: Config::DataPath
methods.description: Constructs a data path string based on a base path and class name.

methods.name: Config::PersistentPath
methods.description: Constructs a persistent storage path, optionally using a postfix or callsign.

methods.name: Config::VolatilePath
methods.description: Constructs a volatile storage path, optionally using a postfix or callsign.

methods.name: Config::IsSameInstance
methods.description: Checks if another Config instance refers to the same system instance based on locator and class name.

methods.name: Config::RootConfig::HostType
methods.description: Determines the host type based on the mode setting.

methods.name: Config::IPV4UnicastNode
methods.description: Static method to get the IPv4 unicast node for a network interface.

methods.name: Setting::Setting
methods.description: Constructors for different types of configuration settings, with logging.
